summary: Provides ABNF grammars equivalent to the Generic String Encoding Rules (GSER) encodings for common elements of ASN.1 types. Specifications that use GSER can use these as a convenience for implementors. It is informational and supports RFC 3641.

eli5.summary: Writing a grammar is like listing which word orders are allowed in a sentence. This gives ready-made grammar pieces so others writing text-based data formats do not have to write them again.
